Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #255 in Moneo: remove the Europe/Berlin fallback from database functions and column defaults. Read the issue for the list.

Several applied migrations fall back to `'Europe/Berlin'` when a workspace has no `workspace_settings` row:
- reservation and reviewed-balance functions
- wealth and goal date checks
- budget rollover
- bank observations
- loan repayments

`workspace_settings.timezone` and `spending_plans.rollover_from` also default to Berlin. Since PR #256, the app saves the detected device time zone on the first workspace load (`requireWorkspace`).

The work: add a new migration that replaces those functions so they raise a clear error when no zone is stored, and drops the column defaults. Keep `lib/schema.ts` aligned.
- Use a unique timestamp prefix later than `202611160051`.
- Never rewrite an applied migration.
- It must run on the desktop backend, so use no extensions the bundle lacks.
- Re-create each function from its LATEST definition, changing only the fallback. Diff the old and new bodies to prove nothing else changed.
- Check that every path creating a workspace (setup, desktop bootstrap SQL in `desktop/bootstrap/`, the QA auth script, tests) still stores a time zone, so nothing starts raising.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 255 --comments`.
- Branch `t3/issue-255-db-time-zone` from current `origin/main`. Commit each step, ending each message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Don't end your turn while a command is still running.** Wait in the same turn.
- **Never kill a process you didn't start yourself in this session, verified by PID.**
- Run one `npm ci` at a time. If it stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- The moneo-qa backend is shared:
  - never `npm run qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`;
  - never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`);
  - if you apply your migration to the QA database for testing, revert it afterwards so other branches' `test:db` isn't broken.
- **Run `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` yourself and quote their last lines in your final reply.** Also run `npm test` and `npm run test:db`. If `test:db` fails on a lock timeout from another checkout, retry once and report it.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #255`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

PR #275 is open for #255 and not merged. Lint, typecheck and `npm test` pass, but `npm run test:db` fails in its upgrade half because of other branches' migrations in the shared QA database.

**What changed**
- **Migration:** `202611160061_workspace_time_zone_required.sql` adds `workspace_time_zone(workspace_id)`, which raises `Workspace time zone is not set` (SQLSTATE 55000) when no zone is stored.
- **Functions:** It rewrites the ten functions that fell back to Berlin to call it. They are patched from their live definitions, not copied from the old files. A later migration (`202610310001`) rewrote `40001` to `PT409` inside them, and copying the old text would have undone that.
- **Diff check:** I dumped the ten functions before and after on the QA database. Only the Berlin fallback lines differ. The migration also fails if any `Europe/Berlin` is left in a function.
- **Defaults:** It drops the defaults on `workspace_settings.timezone` and `spending_plans.rollover_from`, and `lib/schema.ts` matches.
- **`rollover_from`:** A before-insert trigger now fills `rollover_from` from the workspace zone. That keeps the two app code paths that insert spending plans unchanged.
- **Workspace creation paths:** None of them stores a zone, so nothing there needed changes. Setup, desktop bootstrap and the QA auth script leave it to the first workspace load (`requireWorkspace`).
- **Tests and scripts:** About 20 SQL fixtures, `.mjs` tests, live tests and `voice-call-check.mjs` now insert a zone before calling these functions. In the two fixtures that seed every table generically, `reset-workspace.sql` and `workspace-isolation.sql`, I moved `workspace_settings` first in the table list and gave it a zone.

**Last lines of each check**
- `npm run lint`: clean, no output (exit 0).
- `npm run typecheck`: clean, no output (exit 0).
- `npm test`: `Test Files 304 passed | 11 skipped (315)`, `Tests 1725 passed | 17 skipped (1742)`.
- `npm run test:db`: the first half passes: `PASS: fresh replay 137 migrations and 61 SQL regressions; disposable schema rollback verified`. The upgrade half then fails with `Upgrade SQL regression reset-workspace.sql: Missing reset fixture for table scalable_security_charts; update reset coverage`. The shared QA database now has other branches' migrations applied (e.g. `202611160137`), so the failure is not from this change. It was not a lock timeout, so I did not retry.
- The live vitest suites pass except `lib/schema.live.test.ts`, which fails for the same reason: its diff lists only other branches' tables and columns (`scalable_security_charts`, `speech_engine`).
- `reservation-balance-concurrency.mjs` passes.

**QA database:** I applied the migration to `moneo-qa` while testing, then reverted it. The ten function definitions match the dump taken before, the defaults are back and the migration row is gone. The QA database container also restarted once during my runs. I did not touch it and it came back healthy.
